sources.title: Superconducting Circuit Companion—an Introduction with Worked Examples
sources.titleEn: Superconducting Circuit Companion—an Introduction with Worked Examples
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Google 同步讀出：IQ 雲團的可分辨度
related.titleEn: Google simultaneous readout: distinguishability of IQ clouds
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付衰減率帳、2π單位核對與讀出／壽命取捨圖。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mark each item pass, fail or insufficient evidence; a familiar brand is not proof. Final handover must include: Deliver a decay-rate ledger,2π unit check and readout/lifetime tradeoff plot. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『Google 同步讀出：IQ 雲團的可分辨度』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付IQ投影、均值／方差表及保留樣本的混淆矩陣。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'Google simultaneous readout: distinguishability of IQ clouds', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver IQ projections, mean/variance tables and a held-out confusion matrix.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：單模弱耦合代理ΓP=(g/Δ)²κ，κ是能量衰減率s⁻¹，TP=1/ΓP；此處不含濾波器頻率響應。 使用教學g/Δ=0.05、κ=2π×1 MHz；求TP以μs表示。 以手算或試算表計算名義式1/((0.05)**2*2*pi*1e6)*1e6，另開一欄執行獨立核對：驗證比例減半使衰減率四分之一、壽命四倍；確認κ不是直接1 MHz。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：等變異一維投影以d=abs(μ1−μ0)/σ量化分離度；本題不把d直接等同準確率。 使用教學μ0=−1、μ1=1、σ=0.5，單位為任意ADC單位。 以手算或試算表計算名義式(1-(-1))/0.5，另開一欄執行獨立核對：同時把兩均值加10後重算，d應不變；用獨立標註樣本量測混淆矩陣，不能由d推定非高斯尾端。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Single-mode weak-coupling proxy ΓP=(g/Δ)²κ uses energy-decay rate κ in s⁻¹, with TP=1/ΓP; filter response is omitted. Use Teaching g/Δ=0.05 and κ=2π×1 MHz; express TP in μs. Evaluate nominal expression 1/((0.05)**2*2*pi*1e6)*1e6 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Verify halving the ratio quarters decay rate and quadruples lifetime; ensure κ was not mistaken for1 MHz.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: For equal-variance one-dimensional projections, d=abs(μ1−μ0)/σ measures separation; d is not itself accuracy. Use Teaching μ0=−1, μ1=1 and σ=0.5 in arbitrary ADC units. Evaluate nominal expression (1-(-1))/0.5 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Add10 to both means and verify invariant d; measure a confusion matrix on independent labels instead of inferring non-Gaussian tails.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Google 校準監測：頻率漂移與重新校準間隔
related.titleEn: Google calibration monitoring: frequency drift and recalibration interval
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付衰減率帳、2π單位核對與讀出／壽命取捨圖。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mark each item pass, fail or insufficient evidence; a familiar brand is not proof. Final handover must include: Deliver a decay-rate ledger,2π unit check and readout/lifetime tradeoff plot. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『Google 校準監測：頻率漂移與重新校準間隔』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付漂移斜率、相位界線與校準／工作時間圖。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'Google calibration monitoring: frequency drift and recalibration interval', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver drift slope, phase limits and calibration/work timelines.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：單模弱耦合代理ΓP=(g/Δ)²κ，κ是能量衰減率s⁻¹，TP=1/ΓP；此處不含濾波器頻率響應。 使用教學g/Δ=0.05、κ=2π×1 MHz；求TP以μs表示。 以手算或試算表計算名義式1/((0.05)**2*2*pi*1e6)*1e6，另開一欄執行獨立核對：驗證比例減半使衰減率四分之一、壽命四倍；確認κ不是直接1 MHz。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：線性漂移Δf=rt在固定門窗τ形成φ=2πrtτ；僅為短時間預測，突跳或隨機漫步需其他模型。 使用教學漂移r=2 kHz/min，校準後t=10 min，τ=1 μs。 以手算或試算表計算名義式2*pi*2000*10*1e-6，另開一欄執行獨立核對：以0、2、4 min三個合成頻率點確認斜率；外插10 min前查線性殘差。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Single-mode weak-coupling proxy ΓP=(g/Δ)²κ uses energy-decay rate κ in s⁻¹, with TP=1/ΓP; filter response is omitted. Use Teaching g/Δ=0.05 and κ=2π×1 MHz; express TP in μs. Evaluate nominal expression 1/((0.05)**2*2*pi*1e6)*1e6 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Verify halving the ratio quarters decay rate and quadruples lifetime; ensure κ was not mistaken for1 MHz.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Linear drift Δf=rt produces φ=2πrtτ in fixed gate window τ; this short-term model excludes jumps and random walks. Use Teaching drift r=2 kHz/min, elapsed t=10 min and τ=1 μs. Evaluate nominal expression 2*pi*2000*10*1e-6 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Use synthetic0,2,4 min frequencies to confirm slope; inspect linear residuals before extrapolating to10 min.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
